speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to help you, I need to ask a few questions. Has your baby been feeding well, and are they acting normally or appearing irritable and lethargic? When did the rash first appear, and has it changed in color or spread to other areas since then?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Ophthalmia (conjunctivitis) presenting as a generalized pustular rash, likely disseminated gonococcal infection.

REQUEST TEST: Blood culture and Gram stain of skin lesion.
REQUEST IMAGES: Skin lesion close-up.
